body.message:
If a unit is available in the same building, we will be happy to move you there. Please don't worry, the rental rate will remain the same, and there will be no additional charges.

If there is no availability in the same building, we will offer you a unit in a nearby building, subject to availability.

Please note that situations like this are very rare, but we want to be transparent and keep you informed.

Thank you for your understanding.
